text: dsh-maa-cli 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的《明日方舟》自动化工具：它把自然语言任务转换为可预览、需确认的 MAA 计划，并提供本地 /maa 命令和参数面板。主要功能包括战斗与基建计划、社区作业搜索、肉鸽策略编译、干员培养及运行状态管理；适合希望用对话或本地命令安排 MAA 游戏任务的玩家。首次使用会下载独立 maa-cli 运行时，并连接作业与游戏数据服务。

dsh-maa-cli helps Arknights players prepare MAA tasks in DeepSeek Harness. It turns natural-language requests into previewable plans, with local commands and panels for combat, base schedules, copilot jobs, roguelike strategies, and operator training. Execution requires confirmation.
想用一句话安排明日方舟的 MAA 任务
有没有办法先预览计划，确认后再让 MAA 执行？
我想按自然语言给基建干员排班并保存方案
能不能按关卡搜索社区作业，并看看我缺哪些干员？
帮我把肉鸽备注编译成 MAA 能用的策略
想查干员培养建议和刷材料的规划
I want to plan Arknights MAA tasks in plain language.
Can I find a community copilot for a stage and check which operators I own?
Help me create a custom base schedule and confirm it before running.
dsh-maa-cli 的功能「自然语言计划」：将明日方舟任务请求整理为有序 MAA 步骤，展示计划并生成一次性本地确认；确认后才执行。
dsh-maa-cli 的功能「基建排班」：把自然语言房间安排编译为 MAA 排班 JSON，可预览、保存或复用；准备执行前会要求一次性确认。
dsh-maa-cli 的功能「社区作业」：按关卡查找 MAA 社区作业并结合已扫描的干员 Box 排序；选择作业后下载并在执行前展示确认。
dsh-maa-cli 的功能「本地命令」：通过 /maa 命令打开常用操作面板、查看状态或控制任务；本地命令不调用模型。
dsh-maa-cli 使用前须知：首次运行会从 GitHub 获取独立 maa-cli 运行时并解压到用户目录，运行规划还会读取远端关卡与掉率数据。

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：用自然语言「一键」游玩《明日方舟》！

> [!TIP]
> MAA 负责稳定执行，dsh-maa-cli 让它听懂目标、编译策略、记住偏好，并根据真实反馈继续推进。

dsh-maa-cli README · 相比原生 MAA 多了什么：| | 原生 MAA | dsh-maa-cli |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 下达任务 | 在界面里逐项勾选、填参数 | 说一句话，生成计划，确认后执行 |
| 运行中调整 | 只能停止 | 「再打两局就停」「这次 Boss 前停」，可随时查进度 |
| 肉鸽策略 | 自己手动修改资源 JSON 文件 | 备注里写明需求「特种券优先招结城理，让他堵门」(亲测提高自动肉鸽胜率)，自动编译并记住 |
| 基建自定义排班 | 手写排班 | 「制造站全放赤金，XXX放贸易站」 |
| 抄作业 | 自己找作业、自己判断干员够不够 | 按你的 Box 自动搜索作业，失败自动换下一份 |
| 养成 | 无 | 培养建议、材料缺口计算、联合刷图规划 |
| 目标 | 无 | 「完成今天的日常，不用理智药」，按预算分步推进 |
| 出错时 | 看日志自己判断 | 区分已确认与推测的原因，安全时自动重试 |
| 安装 | 下载并配置 MAA | 首次使用自动下载独立运行时 |

text:
dsh-maa-cli README · 快速开始：```text
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-maa-cli
```

或

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-maa-cli
```

安装后**重启 DSH Desktop**，启动模拟器，然后试试：

```text
/maa fight                                    打开理智作战面板
帮我清理基建，再刷 20 次 1-7                    用自然语言准备计划
找一个 H8-4 低配作业，用我 Box 里有的干员打       抄作业
```

第一次执行会自动下载运行时（约 520–630 MB，通常 1–3 分钟）。

dsh-maa-cli README · [本地命令与面板](docs/commands.md)：日常操作不用经过模型：`/maa fight`、`/maa infrast`、`/maa recruit`、`/maa rouge` 等命令直接打开 MAA 风格的参数面板，改完点确认就执行。

- **零模型调用**：命令走 DSH 本地通道，不消耗 token。
- **记住上次设置**：每个面板独立记住上次确认的参数，肉鸽按主题分别记；MAA 更新后只回退失效的字段。
- **运行时指令**：任务运行中在面板里输入「现在停止」「再打两局就停」「这次 Boss 关前停止」「现在打到哪了」。局数、楼层只按 MaaCore 的可靠回调判断，不靠猜。
- **桌面通知**：任务完成、失败或按条件停止时弹通知，不用一直盯着。
- **安全停止**：停止只终止本次任务的进程树，确认进程真正退出后才显示「已停止」；DSH 崩溃重启后会清理残留进程。

dsh-maa-cli README · [自然语言与策略](docs/natural-language.md)：说一句话就能准备一整串任务，比如「先启动游戏，基建换班，再刷 20 次 1-7，最后领奖励」。

- **一次模型调用生成计划**：确认按钮在本地执行，确认时不再调用模型。
- **备注编译成真实策略**：在备注里写「优先招募结城理，让他在前方堵门」，插件会改写 MAA 实际读取的肉鸽招募表和自动战斗配置，而不是只存一段文字。执行完自动恢复原始资源。
- **自动选点**：「堵门」「守蓝门」不用给坐标，插件按地图数据和干员是地面还是高台，自动算出部署位置和朝向。
- **策略记忆**：验证通过的策略会保存下来，下次换种说法也能命中复用；冲突的要求不会执行。
- **肉鸽面板**：主题、模式、难度、分队等选项从当前 MAA 资源读取，新主题上线不用等插件更新；难度默认「MAX」自动取最高。

dsh-maa-cli README · [日常任务、抄作业与目标](docs/tasks.md)：- **刷理智**：只给总次数，代理倍率自动分组；支持「刷到 3 个固源岩组」这种掉落目标。
- **今日开放关卡**：「今天开了哪个芯片本就刷哪个」，按服务器 04:00 换日计算。
- **公招**：默认只确认 3★/4★，出 5★/6★ 时跳过并提醒你手动处理。
- **自然语言基建排班**：「制造站全放赤金，红云放贸易站」编译成 MAA 自定义排班，干员名会校验，没有的干员会提示。
- **按 Box 抄作业**：从 MAA 作业站搜作业，对照你的 Box 标出缺少或练度不够的干员（3 技能要精二等），能打的排前面。
- **失败自动换作业**：作业打输时自动换下一份同关作业，最多换 3 份，每次都弹通知告诉你。
- **目标驱动**：「我要培养结城理，缺什么列出来」「源岩要 20 个，总理智不超过 120」，插件读 Box 和仓库，按预算分步执行，每步确认完成才进入下一步。
- **工作流预设**：把「启动、基建、访问好友、领奖」存成预设，下次一句话复用。

dsh-maa-cli README · [干员与养成](docs/operators.md)：- **Box 问答**：扫描一次后直接问「哪些六星还没精二」「维什戴尔几潜」，只读缓存，不连模拟器。
- **培养建议**：参考社区强度投票的杯级，并考虑你的职业覆盖：哪个职业还没有能用的干员，就优先推荐。
- **养成规划**：精英化、等级、技能、专精、模组都能算，可以一次规划多名干员，对比仓库算出缺口。
- **够不够**：「我的仓库够不够把清流精二？」只读计算，直接回答。
- **刷图规划**：用企鹅物流的掉率和 ArkPlanner 联合优化选关；每次只刷一批，然后重新扫描仓库再规划，避免按期望值刷过头。
dsh-maa-cli README · [运行时与配置](docs/runtime.md)：插件自带独立的 maa-cli 运行时：首次使用时下载，每天检查一次更新（更新时面板会显示进度，失败自动回滚）。它通过独立目录与系统里的 MAA 隔离，删掉目录就能卸载。这一篇还包括环境变量、兼容的系统与模拟器，以及插件能做和不会做的事。
dsh-maa-cli README · [故障排查与常见问题](docs/troubleshooting.md)：模拟器连不上、运行时下载失败、确认后没反应、停止失败等情况的处理方法。插件会记录 MaaCore 回调、任务检查点和 ADB 状态，把失败原因分成「已确认」和「推测」；只有不会造成重复消耗的扫描任务才会自动重试。

dsh-maa-cli README · 许可与致谢：- 插件本身：[MIT](LICENSE)。
- 运行时从官方渠道下载 [MAA](https://github.com/MaaAssistantArknights/MaaAssistantArknights) 与 [maa-cli](https://github.com/MaaAssistantArknights/maa-cli)，遵循各自许可（MAA 为 AGPL-3.0）。
- 感谢 MaaAssistantArknights 团队维护 MAA 与 maa-cli，以及 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件机制。

[简体中文](README.md) | English

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin: play *Arknights* in "one click" with natural language!

> [!TIP]
> MAA does the reliable execution; dsh-maa-cli lets it understand goals, compile strategies, remember preferences, and keep going based on real feedback.

dsh-maa-cli README · What it adds over plain MAA：| | Plain MAA | dsh-maa-cli |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Giving tasks | Tick options and fill in parameters one by one | Say one sentence, get a plan, confirm to run |
| Adjusting a running task | Stop only | "Stop after two more runs", "stop before this boss", check progress any time |
| Integrated Strategies tactics | Edit resource JSON files by hand | Write it in the note — "use the special ticket on Makoto Yuki first and have him block the entrance" (noticeably raised my auto-IS win rate) — compiled and remembered |
| Custom base (RIIC) shifts | Write the schedule by hand | "All factories on Pure Gold, put XXX in the trading post" |
| Copilot jobs | Find a job yourself and check whether you have the operators | Searches jobs that fit your Box; if one fails, switches to the next |
| Operator training | None | Training advice, material gap calculation, joint farming plans |
| Goals | None | "Finish today's dailies without sanity potions", carried out step by step within budget |
| When something fails | Read the logs and judge yourself | Separates confirmed causes from guesses; retries automatically when it is safe |
| Installation | Do

text:
dsh-maa-cli README · Quick start：```text
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-maa-cli
```

or

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-maa-cli
```

After installing, **restart DSH Desktop**, start your emulator, then try:

```text
/maa fight                                                  open the combat (sanity) panel
Clear the base, then farm 1-7 20 times                      prepare a plan in natural language
Find a low-rarity H8-4 job using operators from my Box      run a copilot job
```
dsh-maa-cli README · Quick start：The first run downloads the runtime automatically (about 520–630 MB, usually 1–3 minutes).

dsh-maa-cli README · [Local commands and panels](docs/en/commands.md)：Everyday operations skip the model: `/maa fight`, `/maa infrast`, `/maa recruit`, `/maa rouge` and other commands open MAA-style parameter panels directly; adjust and confirm to run.

dsh-maa-cli README · [Local commands and panels](docs/en/commands.md)：- **No model calls**: commands go through DSH's local channel and spend no tokens.
- **Remembers your last settings**: each panel remembers the parameters you last confirmed, Integrated Strategies per theme; after an MAA update only fields that became invalid fall back.
- **Runtime instructions**: while a task runs, type "stop now", "stop after two more runs", "stop before this boss" or "how far has it got" into the panel. Run counts and floors come only from reliable MaaCore callbacks, never guesses.
- **Desktop notifications**: a notification pops up when a task finishes, fails or stops on a condition, so you don't have to keep watching.
- **Safe stopping**: stopping only kills this task's process tree and shows "Stopped" only after the processes have really exited; leftover processes are cleaned up after DSH crashes and restarts.

dsh-maa-cli README · [Natural language and strategies](docs/en/natural-language.md)：One sentence prepares a whole chain of tasks, e.g. "Start the game, rotate base shifts, farm 1-7 20 times, then collect rewards".

dsh-maa-cli README · [Natural language and strategies](docs/en/natural-language.md)：- **One model call per plan**: the confirm button runs locally; confirming does not call the model again.
- **Notes become real strategies**: write "recruit Makoto Yuki first and have him hold the front" in the note, and the plugin rewrites the IS recruitment table and auto-battle configuration that MAA actually reads, instead of just storing text. The original resources are restored afterwards.
- **Automatic placement**: "block the entrance" and "guard the protection objective" need no coordinates; the plugin computes the deployment tile and direction from map data and whether the operator is melee (ground) or ranged (high ground).
- **Strategy memory**: validated strategies are saved and reused next time, even when phrased differently; conflicting requests are never run.
- **IS panel**: theme, mode, difficulty, squad and other options are read from the current MAA resources, so new themes appear without a plugin update; difficulty defaults to "MAX", the highest available.

dsh-maa-cli README · [Daily tasks, copilot jobs and goals](docs/en/tasks.md)：- **Combat**: give only the total number of runs and MaaCore groups them automatically; drop targets such as "farm until I have 3 Orirock Clusters" are supported.
- **Today's open stages**: "farm whichever chip stage is open today", using the server's 04:00 day boundary.
- **Recruitment**: only 3★/4★ results are confirmed by default; 5★/6★ slots are skipped and you are reminded to handle them yourself.
- **Natural-language base shifts**: "all factories on Pure Gold, Vermeil in the trading post" is compiled into an MAA custom schedule; operator names are checked and ones you don't own are flagged.
- **Copilot jobs that fit your Box**: searches the MAA copilot site and marks operators you lack or haven't trained enough (e.g. S3 needs Elite 2); jobs you can field come first.
- **Automatic job switching**: if a job loses, the next job for the same stage is tried, up to 3 times, with a notification each time.
- **Goal-driven**: "I want to train Makoto Yuki — list what's missing", "I need 20 Orirock, no more than 120 sanity in total"; the plugin reads your Box and depot and proceeds step by step within budget, m

dsh-maa-cli README · [Operators and training](docs/en/operators.md)：- **Box Q&A**: after one scan, ask "which 6★ aren't Elite 2 yet" or "what potential is Wisadel"; answered from the cache without touching the emulator.
- **Training advice**: based on community tier votes and your class coverage — classes where you have no usable operator get priority.
- **Training plans**: promotion, level, skills, masteries and modules, for several operators at once, compared against your depot to find the gap.
- **"Is it enough?"**: "Does my depot have enough to promote Purestream to Elite 2?" is answered read-only.
- **Farming plans**: stage selection is jointly optimized with Penguin Statistics drop rates and ArkPlanner; it farms one batch at a time, then rescans the depot and replans, so it never overfarms on expected values.

dsh-maa-cli README · [Runtime and configuration](docs/en/runtime.md)：The plugin ships its own maa-cli runtime: downloaded on first use and checked for updates once a day (the panel shows progress while updating, and a failed update rolls back). It lives in its own directory, isolated from any MAA on your system, and deleting the directory uninstalls it. This page also covers environment variables, supported systems and emulators, and what the plugin will and won't do.

dsh-maa-cli README · [Troubleshooting and FAQ](docs/en/troubleshooting.md)：What to do when the emulator won't connect, the runtime download fails, nothing happens after confirming, a stop fails, and more. The plugin records MaaCore callbacks, task checkpoints and ADB status, separates failure causes into "confirmed" and "inferred", and only retries scans that cannot cause duplicate spending.

dsh-maa-cli README · License and acknowledgements：- The plugin itself: [MIT](LICENSE).
- The runtime downloads [MAA](https://github.com/MaaAssistantArknights/MaaAssistantArknights) and [maa-cli](https://github.com/MaaAssistantArknights/maa-cli) from their official sources; they follow their own licenses (MAA is AGPL-3.0).
- Thanks to the MaaAssistantArknights team for maintaining MAA and maa-cli, and to DeepSeek Harness for the plugin system.
